blocks.text:
Event signals differ in some ways from other signals. These differences are described
    in the [Event signals](#sec-eventsignals) section in
    the appendix. Here we will use keyboard events and mouse events to show how
    events can be used in a program.
blocks.zh: 事件信号与其他信号在某些方面有所不同。这些差异在附录的[事件信号](#sec-eventsignals)一节中说明。这里我们将用键盘事件和鼠标事件来说明如何在程序中使用事件。

blocks.text:
Whenever you press or release a key, an event is emitted. You can add an
      event controller and connect a signal handler to handle such events.
blocks.zh: 每当你按下或放开一个按键，就会发出一个事件。你可以添加一个事件控制器，并连接信号处理函数来处理此类事件。

blocks.text:
The event signal handler will receive arguments that depend on the type of event.
      For key press events the arguments are (`guint` `keyval`,
      `guint` `keycode`, `Gdk::ModifierType` `state`).
      As described in the [appendix](#sec-eventsignals),
      the key press event signal handler returns a `bool` value, to indicate that
      the signal is fully handled (`true`) or allow event propagation
      (`false`).
blocks.zh: 事件信号处理函数接收的参数取决于事件的类型。对于按键按下事件，参数是（`guint` `keyval`、`guint` `keycode`、`Gdk::ModifierType` `state`）。如[附录](#sec-eventsignals)所述，按键按下事件的信号处理函数返回一个 `bool` 值，表示信号已被完全处理（`true`），或允许事件继续传播（`false`）。

blocks.text:
To determine which key was pressed or released, you read the value of
      the `keyval` argument and compare it with a constant in the
      [
      `<gdk/gdkkeysyms.h>`](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gtk/tree/main/gdk/gdkkeysyms.h) header file. The states of
      modifier keys (shift, ctrl, etc.) are available as bit-flags in
      `state`.
blocks.zh: 要确定哪个键被按下或放开，请读取 `keyval` 参数的值，并把它与头文件 [`<gdk/gdkkeysyms.h>`](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gtk/tree/main/gdk/gdkkeysyms.h) 中的常量比较。修饰键（shift、ctrl 等）的状态以位标志的形式出现在 `state` 中。

blocks.text:
In this example there are three keyboard shortcuts:
        Alt+1 selects the first radio button,
        Alt+2 selects the second one, and the
        Esc key closes the window.
blocks.zh: 在此示例中有三个键盘快捷键：Alt+1 选择第一个单选按钮，Alt+2 选择第二个，Esc 键关闭窗口。
